query:
SELECT p.id, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, (p.totalHours - p.usedHours) as remainingHours, p.endDate, p.isActive, p.createdAt
FROM packages p
JOIN residents r ON p.residentId = r.id
WHERE r.firstName = 'Nicolas' AND r.lastName = 'Klein'
ORDER BY p.id DESC
LIMIT 5;
